style_prompt:
STYLE CONTRACT CPS6-paper-2a026e31fb
Keep this same visual system across every figure in the document.
Palette: background #FFFFFF; ink #263238; primary #EDF2F5; secondary #E8EEE8; muted #F7F8F9.
A compact publication figure on pure white, like an architecture-paper hardware diagram. No shadows, glow, depth, texture or gradients.
Geometry follows hardware role: shallow queue/register bars, tight compute rectangles, interfaces with aligned ports, taller banked memories only when supported by their specification. Do not use uniform square cards.
Use subdued blue-gray for compute and pale sage for storage; control and interfaces stay white. Color is sparse and follows role; at most three fill roles plus neutral gray.
One neutral sans-serif family, normal/medium-weight module names and regular signal labels. Thin dark data lines, slightly thinner gray dashed control lines, small arrowheads. Group titles are subordinate and boundaries do not create large empty panels.
Design for insertion at 160 mm width: module labels 9 pt and signal labels 8.5 pt, approximately 32 px and 30 px at 1600 px width. Derive pixels from the actual canvas width. Keep this type scale; when space is insufficient, redesign the projection or orientation rather than shrink letters. Use medium-weight names and regular signal labels.
A small 3% white perimeter and compact signal corridors. Containers have very thin neutral outlines with little padding, never large empty blue frames. Solid fills only; no page texture. Use Noto Sans CJK / Microsoft YaHei-like sans-serif for Chinese.
Use narrow engineering strokes and small arrowheads; primary paths may be slightly stronger but never thick flowchart arrows. Labels sit in open gaps. A crossing without a dot is not a connection.
Use a concise legend only for conventions actually used. No ornamental page furniture.

spec.title: Generic SoC System Overview
spec.summary: 面向“完整的 SoC 系统”的通用示意：以片上总线/互联为中心，左侧为计算子系统（CPU 集群、加速器），右侧为存储层次与片外 DRAM，下方为外设与安全/调试子系统，顶部为时钟复位与电源管理。所有模块与连接均为按常见工程实践补入的通用示例，可按实际设计增删。

groups.label: Compute Subsystem
groups.rationale: SoC 通常以计算子系统为核心，先建立功能分区

groups.label: Memory Subsystem
groups.rationale: 区分片上存储层次与片外 DRAM 归属

groups.label: Peripheral & IO Subsystem
groups.rationale: 外设与对外接口通常独立成区

groups.label: System Management
groups.rationale: 时钟复位、电源与安全调试属于全局支撑功能

groups.label: Off-Chip
groups.rationale: 片外器件应置于芯片边界之外

nodes.label: CPU Cluster
nodes.rationale: 通用 SoC 的主控计算单元

nodes.label: Accelerator / DSP
nodes.rationale: 现代 SoC 常含专用加速器

nodes.label: DMA Engine
nodes.rationale: 负责外设与存储间批量搬运

nodes.label: On-Chip Interconnect
nodes.rationale: 作为全片共享互联主干

nodes.label: DRAM Controller
nodes.rationale: 片上控制器，连接片外 DRAM

nodes.label: External DRAM
nodes.rationale: 片外主存，位于芯片边界之外

edges.label: read/write
edges.rationale: CPU 经互联访问存储与外设

edges.label: burst
edges.rationale: DMA 通过互联搬运数据

edges.label: access
edges.rationale: 互联到片上 SRAM 的访问路径

edges.label: access
edges.rationale: 互联到 DRAM 控制器的访问路径

edges.label: req
edges.rationale: 外设请求 DMA 搬运

spec.layout: Main view left-to-right: g_compute on the left, n_noc as the central vertical spine, g_mem on the right, g_offchip (n_dram, n_host) at the far right outside the chip boundary. g_periph sits bottom-center below the interconnect; g_sys spans the top as a shallow band. Reading order: compute -> interconnect -> memory/peripherals -> off-chip. Reserve a lower corridor for the n_memctl->n_noc response and a top corridor for clock/power/security control lines.
annotations: Chip boundary encloses all groups except g_offchip.
All blocks and links are generic illustrative choices, not a specific product.
assumptions: 按通用 SoC 参考设计补入 CPU 集群、加速器、DMA、片上 SRAM、DRAM 控制器、外设、高速 IO、时钟复位、电源管理与安全调试等模块。
片外 DRAM 与主机/外部设备置于芯片边界之外，仅由片上控制器/接口连接。
互联被抽象为单一共享主干，未指定协议、位宽、拓扑或仲裁策略。
未给出具体容量、频率、核数等数值，图中不标注此类参数。
questions: 是否需要把互联展开为多主多从的拓扑（如 crossbar/NoC）？
是否需要补充中断控制器或低功耗域划分等子系统？
checks: 确认计算子系统与存储子系统的边界是否符合目标芯片的物理归属。
确认外设与高速接口清单是否覆盖实际需求。
确认时钟/电源/安全控制线是否需要单独成图。
